resources.string: Clone GitHub, public, self-hosted or SSH repositories. Each working copy keeps its own connection and branch.
Browse and edit files here, or choose a device folder for another editor such as Obsidian. Review folder access in Settings before cloning.
Inspect diffs, stage selected changes and commit locally. Push when you are ready. Branches, history, tags, conflict resolution and Git LFS are available from the repository screen.
Connect an account, clone a URL, or try the offline sample. You can also choose a storage location now.
Tour progress could not be saved. You can continue; the tour may appear again next time.
No app could open this link. You can copy the support email instead.
Browse and edit files, review staged and unstaged diffs, commit locally, push existing commits, and work with branches, history, tags and rebase.
Manage GitHub accounts and repository author identity. Connect over HTTPS or SSH, choose clone storage, reconnect local copies, and review repository moves or removal.
Review Git LFS tracking, download missing contents and inspect server lock warnings. Diagnostics keeps a bounded local log with filtered copy and sharing.
Selected large files with unknown extensions keep exact-path rules.
